title: Isaac Bickerstaff, Physician and Astrologer
author: Steele, Richard, Sir
description: "Issac Bickerstaff, Physician and Astrologer" by Sir Richard Steele is a collection of essays originally published in journals during the early 18th century.
longDescription: The book is centered around the character of Isaac Bickerstaff, a fictional physician and astrologer who provides commentary on the social mores and behaviors of his time through thoughtful and often humorous essays that reflect the cultural life of his era.

authorInfo.bio: Steele, Richard, Sir (1672–1729) wrote Isaac Bickerstaff, Physician and Astrologer. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
